Stop trying servers, drop the connection being made,

randomserverfinder.how_the_party_behaves: How the party behaves: following, locking, size
randomserverfinder.tip.opens_a_port_on_t:
Opens a port on this machine for friends to connect to.
They will need your IP, and the port forwarded if they are
not on your network, the same as hosting any server.
randomserverfinder.tip.connecting_by_add:
Connecting by address rather than username: matching a name to a
machine needs a directory server that tracks who is online, and
this mod has no backend at all. Usernames are exchanged once
you are connected, so the member list still shows who is there.
